title: limonium australe
intro: Limonium australe, commonly known as Tasmanian sea lavender, is a plant species native to Australia and Tasmania. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Limonium australe are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and potential uses.
